lead: Salim Durani was an Indian cricketer, born on 11 December 1934 in Kabul.
He died on 2 April 2023 in Jamnagar at the age of 88.
He has represented India national cricket team and Saurashtra cricket team and has been recognised with the Arjuna Award.
This profile collects the Salim facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
